name: 'duş ve kişisel bakım öğlen 12de olacak, cezaları öde 12.30a kaysın, acme cumartesiye kaysın': add, move the event, move the TASK; the task move never touches the fines event
incident: 2026-11-20 11:23. Three clauses: shower 12:00 added; the fines event moved to 12:30; the Acme TASK moved to Saturday. Sebastian moved the wrong thing (the fines) for the last clause. Tasks, events and lists are separate domains; a move naming a task changes the task's day only.

steps.say: dus ve kisisel bakim oglen 12de olacak cezalari ode 12.30a kaysin acme cumartesiye kaysin
